Method of Attack: Local privilege escalation by running co-installer software with SYSTEM privileges during USB device plug-in, allowing execution of PowerShell with SYSTEM privileges.
Attack Vector: Plugging in vulnerable USB devices that trigger co-installer execution during Windows Plug-and-Play driver installation.
Indicators of Compromise: Execution of Razer Synapse software with SYSTEM privileges
Opening PowerShell console with SYSTEM privileges during 'Choose a Folder' dialog
